svg.title: Path — from operator to instructor
svg.desc: NOW: Programming Instructor, 10X ACADEMY · TENIXI LLC. Teaching JavaScript & React. For every concept taught, I explore tenfold. EARLIER: Mentor, 10X ACADEMY. Same team, earlier role — mentoring to learn. 2020 — 2026: Operator, BATUMI OIL TERMINAL. Complex systems where failure is not an option. That discipline came with me. Languages: Georgian (native), Russian (C2), English (B2), Turkish (A2).
